nom: SkinMedica Retinol Serum 0.25 Complex - Serum for Face

avis.texte: I can't say enough about this product. When it comes to skin care price is not the biggest factor as long as the product genuinely works and let me tell you, this product WORKS!!! IT WORKS!!! Please be careful with this retinol if u decide to go for the 1.0 strength cuz u don't have sensitive skin because u WILL burn n peel off this stuff. I made the mistake and did this treatment two nights in a row and oh boy!!! I couldn't treat my face again for 2 weeks!! It literally felt like I got a chemical peel 💯. I tell u what tho my skin is beaming and tight, lifted, pores shrunk and fine lines gone. Even my hard creases in my forhead relaxed sum and that's all off one treatment. I may get a weaker strength so I can use it more often. Forget about any other retinol buy this!!

I’ve been using SkinMedica Retinol 1.0 for several months and the results are impressive. This is definitely the best retinol you can buy without prescription. Best for people who already have experience with retinoids, not recommended for beginners . The first days I had some redness and flaking, which is normal for a 1.0% retinol. After few weeks of using my skin looked much smoother, pores appeared smaller, and my overall tone became more even. I use it only at night with a rich moisturizer. You must use sunscreen daily

avis.titre: Seems expensive, but I took a chance and am very pleased with this product.
avis.texte: Expensive, but worth the price. I have found it difficult to find an over the counter retinol product that works. This seems effective. I found that using it daily did dry my face and I had some minor peeling, but after that initial phase those effects resolved. I have fairly sensitive skin and I am tolerating it well. I do use a good moisturizer. If it seems to irritating starting with applications less frequently, as most retinol products recommend, should help ease your skin into it. The pump dispenses a small drop per pump and that is enough for my face and neck. I will purchase this again, although this bottle should last quite a while given the small amount used for each application.

avis.titre: Great product. Don't  think it twice  to get it.
avis.texte: I was using the .5 and started with the 1.0 just a week ago. I can see the difference in just one week. I have mix skin with acne scars and sun marks. Skin got softly peeled and already got a firmer and smoother look. I highly recommend but judging for it's immediate action I would say to take breaks for sensitive skins in between usage. For the rest this product is high quality. Highly recommended.

avis.titre: So far, so good.  No negative effects, tho no positive effects yet either.
avis.texte: Not sure how to rate this yet. I decided to heed the "go low and slow" advice, and start with the .25% strength (fs full strength). Started with once per week as advised, now moving to twice a week. So far none of the negative effects, but not real noticeable improvement yet, but its only been 2 weeks, aka 2 applications. I'll have to come back and update this in a few months...

avis.titre: Great product to be used at night
avis.texte: Great product. Make sure to use it at night only as it is not to be used in the sun. My skin is glowing and looks beautiful.
Best retinol on the market. Great for sensitive skin. Worth the price
El producto es rellenado y literal me hipersensibilizo y casi quemo la piel
Es un buen recibió, se nota en poco tiempo cambios en la piel. Recomendable la marca

I’ve bought this several times. I’m 47 and have all the fine lines and sun damage. It’s definitely strong! I recommend using once a week at first if you haven’t used retinol before. No irritation and I just apply a thin layer of lotion before and after application. Works just as well or better than prescription. I’ve used retinol and trentoin and this is my favorite

avis.titre: Slowly increase your tolerance! Magic in a bottle!
avis.texte: A doctor a visit regularly recommended this to me and I believe it’s worth every penny! I’ve moved up from the 0.25 to 1.0 since I finished my 0.25 bottle! I used this three times week to slowly increase my tolerance, now I’m t it every night! I’ve added a “Tips for Retinol” card my doctor gave me and it’s helped a lot! Hope this helps!
My skin has never looked better, thanks to this retinol. 10/10 recommend. I have tried a few other retinol products and this one by far trumps them all. Worth the price.

avis.titre: Burns my skin & leaves it red
avis.texte: This is my first ever retinol purchase. I have very good skin and I purchased this for anti-aging purposes. I followed the instructions knowing about the potential side effects. My skin turned red and was burning for a while. I learned that the skin closer to my nose and mouth is extra sensitive and so I try to avoid it as much as possible. I’ve also noticed that I’m starting to get some small zits (I’ve never had any acne issue) but I read that this is common with retinol. I haven’t been using it for long enough to see a difference or notice its effect but I can say that the more I use it, the less redness and burning.

I ordered this product back in August after seeing such great reviews on various sites. Well I’ve been using it about 4 months now and haven’t noticed much of anything. I go to the actual Skinmedica site to view other products when I see they’ve released a statement. They are warning consumers not to purchase any of their products from Amazon and several other sites. They say the products being sold are either defaulted, expired, or diluted. I know I can’t prove if it’s been diluted or if it’s a faulty product but I decide to check the dates. I go check my box it says 2016. I check the bottle it says 2014. That’s 3 years old. It doesn’t make much sense that the bottle and box would have separate dates. I’m really upset and I wish I would’ve known sooner since the return window time has been closed. But I’d hate to see anyone else waste their money. You can read the article on the SkinMedica website.

I have several bottles from the dermatologist office. I thought I found a great resource here, however, the color is way off. It is very yellow and you cant feel it working at all. The bottle is full but feel like it may be old and past its prime. The packaging was not tampered with and the same as the doctors but it does not feel the same.
I receiced my order but absolutely not satisfied!! It's like the bottle is empty. No liquid comes up when I pump the bottle.

I love this product. It's efficacy is science-backed and it's price is fair. But I ordered the 1% and to my disappointment received the. 25% instead. Not sure what to say about this, other than I would have much preferred receiving what I actually ordered.
